ac3_design.source: pt15u (ChatGPT checkpoint relayed by Ian, 20:57 EDT)
ac3_design.chosen: runtime computation in the gate + run artifact + evidence/acceptance branch
ac3_design.why: A MET written into tasks.json changes the SHA it describes (self-referential loop), and a bare met_for_sha did not bind the base or the tested merge. Computing AC3 inside the run that executed the checks binds it to GitHub's own record of that run (run id, attempt, event, head and merge SHAs). It needs no write permission (the workflow keeps contents: read), and no extra credential.

rejected.commit status / check-run: needs statuses:write or checks:write on GITHUB_TOKEN; not needed for correctness
rejected.annotated tag per decision: would work, but adds refs per run; the evidence branch covers human-readable mirroring
rejected.query older runs via API: would let one run vouch for another; the current run's needs are authoritative
